coverage: Composed gift: a prepared current card and target survive re-execution of its original active action. Revision, accepted commands, movements and player view stay fixed. Primary confirmation submits exactly one UseProgramSkill command with the skill/activation, selected physical card and target.

Foreign public pile: a command and action parameter captured from a real rendered supplemental Button are rejected after real manual reload; an equal current action copy cannot choose its owner/target contract. Restored supplemental parameters are verified as references to current HumanActiveSkillActions objects.

Prepared public-pile draft: the original action, the same-owner base target contract, and a different current owner each fail to replace or submit the draft. Each attempt immediately checks six client identity fields, selected cost IDs, targets, prompt/selection text and current Core state. Existing tutorial restoration, exact two foreign costs, private actor hand and cold replay remain covered.

Zero-material actions: an equal action copy cannot open a target draft; copied and original button parameters cannot reset an already prepared target set. Current cancel/reselect and primary confirmation preserve exact PlayCard identity, ordered targets and every conversion source. Existing draw-funded private child and chained-state payment checks remain.

Wooden Ox: the current rendered button's command/parameter still opens a legal hand-cost draft. Confirmation actually stores the physical card while preserving its reused hand container and updating its grain presentation.

No-target Alcohol: render and capture its old button, load the same checkpoint, prove equal record values with different object references, require the supplemental list and new rendered button to reference the current action, reject the old parameter without paying, and submit exactly one current PlayCard. Complete the actual private draw child and verify one draw paid, exact issued source, native AlcoholApplied and CardUseFinished on the issued owner frame, public Alcohol effect, no zero-ID physical movements, and player-view/movement cold replay.
